verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's integrated authenticator generates TOTP codes inside the vault, and the TOTP sync docs say that once Authenticator is connected to Password Manager, the apps stay synchronized with any codes you add or edit. Vault items are also used through both the browser extension and the mobile apps, so tokens reach several device types. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of simultaneous phone, tablet and computer availability; detail on how sync behaves offline or with conflicting edits; independent hands-on confirmation that token sync is reliable.
